diagnostics.message: module.cloudtrail_baseline:resource.aws_cloudtrail.global sets sns_topic_name from aws_sns_topic.cloudtrail-sns-topic, so it waits for the topic but not for aws_sns_topic_policy.local-account-cloudtrail. CloudTrail validates at CreateTrail time that the SNS topic policy allows cloudtrail.amazonaws.com to publish (otherwise it fails with InsufficientSnsTopicPolicyException), so the trail must be created after the topic policy exists.

module.cloudtrail_baseline:resource.aws_cloudtrail.global is given s3_bucket_name (the audit log bucket) but has no ordering against aws_s3_bucket_policy.audit_log, which is what grants cloudtrail.amazonaws.com s3:GetBucketAcl / s3:PutObject. CreateTrail validates the bucket policy and fails with InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException if the policy is not yet applied (the provider documentation's own example uses depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.example] for exactly this reason). The trail must depend on the bucket policy resource.

:resource.aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization only references aws_iam_role.config_organization.arn, so it can be created before :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization attaches AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations. Creating an organization-source aggregator requires the role to already carry that policy (it calls Organizations APIs through the role), so the aggregator must depend on the policy attachment — the provider documentation's organization example includes depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.organization].
